original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-BG-algebraic}
Let $k$ be a field. Let $G$ be an affine group scheme over $k$.
If the stack $[\Spec(k)/G]$ has a smooth covering by a
scheme, then $G$ is of finite type over $k$.
